tools.note: Catalog search does not grant execution

invariants: workspace tools reject absolute paths and .. (workspace.forbidden)
workspace_search hits include locators so workspace_read can fetch ranges
workspace_read truncation is labeled via next_cursor / truncated
digest mismatch returns resource.revision_mismatch without silent fallback
tools_search never executes the matched tool
Search-then-read is the intended loop; search alone is not verified content
